Eredin's deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the four turtles', Doctor Strange's, Bigfoot's, Daredevil's, Luke Cage's, Bullseye's and Tomoe Gozen's: only deck.identity (data/tts/eredin.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Hero card (read from the image): EREDIN, MELEE, START HEALTH 14, MOVE 2; special ability 'KING OF THE WILD HUNT: While all of your Red Riders are defeated, Eredin is ENRAGED. If Eredin is ENRAGED, add +1 to the value of your combat cards, and your move value is 3.' Sidekick RED RIDERS, MELEE, START HEALTH 1, x4 (the save has four tokens: Maxwell, Aleksei, Adrian, Norman).

Bands (fighter restrictions) read from the card images: Backhand, Brutal Strike, Implacable, Portal Defense and Might Of The Aen Elle are EREDIN; Unyielding Hordes is RED RIDER (3 copies, played by a Red Rider); Foul Purpose, Icy Guile, Wild Hunt, Skirmish and Close For The Kill are ANY.

Texts differ from unmatched-memory on Might Of The Aen Elle (the real card carries an ONGOING that unmatched-memory dropped), Portal Defense ('ow the defender' typo) and Icy Guile ('Red Riper' typo): the card text wins. Titles: unmatched-memory writes them in lower case, the cards in capitals; `memory_title` bridges them.
